notes: Three pages of a 1903 bill: two columns (Greek | French treaty text) on thin paper with strong show-through from the reverse side (page.jpg). The page-1 reading is badly fragmented: most anomalous lines are gutter merges joining two columns (22-25, 27-29, 32-34, 38). In 21, 30, 31 and 39 the label belongs to a different line than the crop (21 and 25 share the same crop). Even unflagged random lines carry errors: 4 'κοὶ ... τὴς' for 'καὶ ... τὴν', a spurious '5' in 6, garbled 'Συ βάσεως ἔτους, ς,' in 7. With only 263 lines, removing the flagged subset would still leave a high residual error rate.
